preTriageOpportunities.summary: DOC-001166 already evaluates retrieval practice as a learning mechanism; a new scenario would not add a distinct construct.
DOC-001171 already evaluates worked examples as a didactic device for transferable learning; the adjacent novice worked-example effect did not clear C2's marginal-value threshold.
Evidence supports interleaving under moderated conditions; a general teacher item would overgeneralize the decisive condition.
PBIS-associated preventive practices have supportive evidence, but the reviewed evidence did not justify one universally best combination for a general Colombian teacher item.
